title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-fix
author: Evan Liu
release_notes: Fixes incorrect burst utilization metrics for priority routing in the Dedicated autoscaler. Corrects double-counting when requests transit priority queues and backfills corrected utilization metrics for the last 24h.
description: Context: priority routing in the Dedicated autoscaler incorrectly attributed queued tokens to both the priority lane and the shared pool when a request moved between queues. This led to inflated per-priority utilization numbers and misleading alerts. Motivation: customers on Dedicated fleets rely on per-priority utilization for capacity planning and billing reconciliation. This PR fixes metric aggregation and adds stronger test coverage and integration checks.
commits: fix(metrics): stop double-counting queued tokens when migrating between priority queues
test(metrics): add unit tests for priority queue accounting and edge cases
integration(test): add e2e that simulates priority bump and verifies backfilled metrics
diff_snippets: + // only attribute tokens to the new lane after drain completes
+ // backfill last 24h for corrected priority attribution
review_comments: Priya Shah: Found a race where transition flag wasn't set for fast drains - added a note and asked for a deterministic test
Evan Liu (author): Added deterministic e2e that artificially delays drain completion and asserts metrics don't double-count
Diego Morales: Can you document the backfill behavior in the observability docs? Suggested adding a short notice to the dashboard's description
Sophie Carter: CI flake on integration; reran tests and they passed. Approving once the test timeout is reduced.
Priya Shah: Approving after timeout reduction and small comment cleanup.
qa_steps: 1) Run unit tests: cargo test services/dedicated-autoscaler -p priority_accounting
3) Smoke verify metrics: query dedicated_priority_utilization dashboard for last 1h
4) Backfill verification: ensure corrected metrics appear for the 24h window after deployment
risk_mitigation: Feature guarded behind rollout flag: dedicated.autoscaler.priority_metrics_fix (default enabled for controlled rollout)
Canary rollout to 10% of fleets for 24h before full rollout
Rollback: revert the feature flag or revert the merge commit
notes: Backfilled metrics will replace previously reported utilization for affected priority lanes for a 24h window. Customers will be notified by SRE if their fleet is in the canary cohort.
This PR reduces noise from false alerts caused by inflated priority utilization and improves billing reconciliation accuracy for Dedicated customers.
